3. ESTABLISH - NO PARKING, TUESDAYS AND FRIDAYS, 2AM – 5AM
Oakdale Avenue, north side, from 150 feet to 183 feet east of Keith Street
(Supervisor District 10) (Approvable by the City Traffic Engineer) André Wright,
[staff email removed — see the order]

This proposal restricts parking next to the school's campus entrance gate to allow proper access to the
campus.

Public Comments: Comments in opposition, support, and neutrality were received at the public
hearing.
Decision: Modified proposed hours from a NO PARKING ANYTIME restriction to a No Parking,
Tuesday and Friday, 2AM-5AM restriction around Recology pickup times based on feedback from the
neighborhood and the Principal of the elementary school. Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for
implementation.

ESTABLISH – BIKE SHARE STATION
Folsom Street, north side, from 30 feet to 125 feet west of 1st Street (Supervisor District 6)
(Approvable by the City Traffic Engineer) 

Proposal to relocate the 1st /Folsom bikeshare station around the corner into the floating buffer on
the north side of Folsom Street, west of 1st Street, and convert the station to angled docks so it fits in
the 6-foot-wide buffer.

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
